meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin tones par white cast (safed layer) na chhodein, uske liye aisi sunscreens best hoti hain jo **chemical** ya **lightweight hybrid filters** se bani hon. Yeh skin mein easily absorb ho jati hain.

Kuch behtareen sunscreens jo bina white cast ke aati hain:

Re'equil Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ Ultra Matte Dry Touch Gel oily aur combination skin ke liye ek **cult favorite** hai jo bilkul **zero white cast** aur dry-touch matte finish deti hai.

Minimalist SPF 50 Sunscreen ek lightweight formula hai jo skin mein asaani se blend ho jata hai aur **vitamins ke sath natural finish** deta hai.

The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic SPF 50 Sunscreen Aqua Gel dry aur normal skin ke liye acchi hai jo **hyaluronic acid** ke sath skin ko hydrated rakhti hai aur bina sticky feel ke glow deti hai.

Plum 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water SPF 50 PA+++ Hybrid Sunscreen niacinamide aur rice water ke faydon ke sath aati hai, jo skin ko protect karti hai aur **tan reduction** mein madad kart करती hai.

Dot & Key Cica Calming Mattifying Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ acne-prone aur sensitive skin ke liye best hai kyunki yeh **cica aur niacinamide** ke sath redness ko calm karti hai aur koi white cast nahi chhodti.

Neutrogena Nuetrogena UltraSheer Fluid Sunscreen water-light texture wali fluid sunscreen hai jo skin par **weightless aur invisible** feel deti hai.

### Summary Guide:

* **Agar aapki skin Oily hai:** Re'equil Ultra Matte ya Dot & Key Cica Sunscreen chun sakte hain.
* **Agar aapki skin Dry ya Normal hai:[theprint.in](https://theprint.in/brandit/7-best-lightweight-no-white-cast-glow-sunscreen-in-india/3066812/#:~:text=It%20spreads%20easily%20and%20feels%20more%20like,turmeric%20helps%20calm%20skin%20after%20sun%20exposure.)** Minimalist SPF 50 ya The Derma Co Hyaluronic Sunscreen behtar rahengi.

Agar aap chahte hain ki main aapki skin type (jaise oily, dry ya combination) ke hisab se inmein se sabse sahi option chunne mein madad karun, toh aap bata sakte hain.
